subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Future of Procurement
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Future of Procurement.

hook.text: Tomorrow's procurement team will be small, data-driven, and strategic. Automation handles the transactions.

buildup.text: Routine buying is being automated. What remains for humans is strategy, relationships, and risk management.

discovery.text: Procurement is shifting from cost-cutter to value-creator—driving innovation, sustainability, and resilience.

twist.text: The transformation requires new skills: data literacy, market intelligence, and cross-functional collaboration.

climax.text: Companies that elevate procurement to the C-suite outperform peers on margins, innovation, and agility.

punchline.text: Procurement's future is strategic. The buying part is automated.

quiz.question: What role is procurement shifting toward?
options: Strategic value creation and risk management
